original: 送ってもらったお金じゃ足りないんだよ。

en.text: The money you sent isn't enough.
The money you sent me isn't enough.

original: 平凡な毎日を送っている。

en.text: I live an ordinary life.

original: 必要とあらば、どこへでも車で送ってあげますよ。

en.text: I'll drive you anywhere you need to go.

original: いつ送ってくれるの？

en.text: When are you going to send it to me?

original: そんなショートメール、送った覚えないけど。

en.text: I don't remember sending that text message.

original: 彼女にメッセージを送ってくれ。

en.text: Send her a message.

original: トムは母の日に母親に花束を送った。

en.text: Tom sent his mother some flowers on Mother's Day.

original: トムが僕に送ったって言ってた荷物、届かなかったんだ。

en.text: I never received the package that Tom said he sent me.
I never got the package that Tom said he'd sent me.
